decisions.reason: The manual copying request is a remediation for the current profile-mapping problem, not a change to the template or expansion strategy for future locations.
Copying site content into another profile does not change the required master domain or its domain-to-website association.
The remediation method does not alter the requirement that each location have its own website connected through the master site.
The source decision concerns moving site content between profiles and does not change location selection or routing on the master site.
Manually copying content into another profile does not change the standing requirement for separate Wix accounts per location.
The requested profile-remediation method does not alter the approved layout, navigation, or visual design references.
The source decision does not change the requirement for a mobile-friendly design.
Copying site content to the correct profile does not change the brand name, logo, palette, positioning, or cross-location consistency requirements.
The source message does not change package content or pricing consistency across location websites.
The profile-copy remediation does not add, remove, or alter any required master-homepage section or content rule.
The source decision concerns site-content placement and does not change booking placement, isolation, or activation rules.
The requested copying method does not change the requirement that the legacy site remain available or linked during the transition.
